slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: episodes
slots.about: the latest things from what the person follows: id, show (the name of the thing it belongs to), title, date (published), minutes

slots.name: today_word
slots.about: the hero's update line when the newest came out today

slots.name: yesterday_word
slots.about: the hero's update line when it came out yesterday

slots.name: days_ago_word
slots.about: after the count of days on the hero's update line

slots.name: minutes_word
slots.about: after the minutes on a row

slots.name: play_word
slots.about: spoken before a title on its play button when not playing

slots.name: pause_word
slots.about: spoken before a title on its play button when playing

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when nothing came out yet

empty.shows: empty; the hero and the list hide

attention.shows: the playing item's buttons fill and show pause, in the hero and in its row

labels.hero: play_word or pause_word and the newest title
labels.play: play_word or pause_word and the title

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: The hero is the thing that updated last, made from the newest row, so it can never disagree with the list. Equal dates keep the lower id first.
